_comment: The gas station the garage's Gas Station button drives to: our own, built by tools/StationScene (build_station.py:
compose_station.py in Blender, prepare_prop.py, StationSceneBuilder; see docs/screens/gas-station.md). station.kn5
holds the forecourt, the road, the office, the pumps under their canopy and the dressing, with a sky dome for each
light of the day (STATION_SKY_DAY, _DUSK, _NIGHT); ground.bin the ground's height under it. Change the builder, not
these files; the attendant is a prop of his own (props/attendant).
Positions are metres from the middle of the forecourt, x and z; +z is towards the road, which runs along x at
z 26.5..34 (the lane nearer the station at 28.4). The canopy's two pump islands run along x at z = 2 and z = 10,
a pump at each end (x = -1.6 and 1.6); the car stops in the lane between them, its driver's door to the island at
z = 2, the attendant by it. A car's heading follows the path.
arrive: the way in, off the road to the pump; the car rolls in at the first point and stops at the last.
leave: the way out, from the pump (its first point) back onto the road; the screen goes when the car is gone.
lookAtPump: where the driver looks while the tank fills, degrees from straight ahead, to the left positive;
lookUpAtPump: how far up, degrees over the seat's own look (to the attendant's face).
attendant: where he stands (x, z; y up over the ground's height there, which ground.bin already raises on the islands, so 0 on one;
heading degrees about the vertical, 0 facing +z) and which actor prop he is (props/<prop>/prop.json: a model with a skin on bones and its animation).
sun: the key light's direction by day, towards the sun. lights: as a street's (see streets/mainstreet/street.json);
lamps are lit at night at x, y, z. glow: how bright each self-lit material glows at a light of the day (0 to 4):
the tubes under the canopy, the pumps' globes, the office's lights; the materials are named as in
compose_station.py's Blender scene and the models.
prices: a litre of gas, a litre of oil, a wash, the tow truck; left out, the base game's.
title: Crossroads Gas
